analysis:
Examined the supplied inference-handler excerpt, model-loading patch, BASE context and file metadata against the indexed model and detailed T-041. No independently supported regression is established in this scope.

ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift HEAD 550–563 and 615–624 replace GLM's two bracketing hash observations with managed-load verification, then pass the same verified snapshot to both inputs of finalizeReusableSSDLoad. Security now depends on verifiedGLM5NextWeightHash and the managed native loader proving the identity of bytes actually consumed, including mutation during loading; the unchanged comparator alone no longer provides that check for GLM. Integration must inspect those implementations and recordVerifiedGLM5NextWeightHash's identity-cache rules under T-012/T-027 and T-041. Also verify loadWeightHasher's production default and injection access: HEAD 47/76 replace direct WeightHasher calls. These missing implementations are coverage limits, not proof of bypass.

ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler.swift HEAD 1149 and 1219 broaden deadline exemption and TTFT timing from withheld reasoning to withheld output. Verify the signal producer timestamps real generated output and that cancellation remains bounded (T-010); visible cancellation settlement still ties billing to delivered output (1379–1436). Response hashing and completion attestation remain tied to emitted text (1184–1207, 1516–1541), with no visible plaintext fallback (T-008). HEAD 1325 adds GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice.report to sanitized error handling; inspect that helper for raw prompt/error disclosure, and reconcile the other added call sites at 577/1023 in integration. No supplied change directly alters serving authorization, token custody, cache scope, at-rest encryption or privileged fan authority.
